title: Quaint Peppery Dutch Apple Skillet
description: A traditional Dutch dish with a twist, featuring braeburn apples and a hint of pepper, all in one comal skillet. This halal-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dessert.
instructions: Preheat the comal skillet over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the eggs, milk, and melted butter to the bowl and mix until smooth.
Add the sliced apples, chopped pickle, and black pepper to the bowl and stir until combined.
Pour the mixture into the preheated comal skillet.
Cook for 20 minutes or until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the skillet towards the center.
Continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes or until the skillet is golden brown and set.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the skillet into wedges and serve warm.
